svg.title: 2. Promotion across accounts
svg.text: Tooling account: promotion pipeline (CodePipeline V2, QUEUED execution mode)
# changes only when this PR merges
Promotion: the same digest moves dev, staging, prod, one pull request at a time
A CodePipeline V2 promotion pipeline decides when. Git records what. Argo CD in each environment makes it so. Rebuilding per environment is not allowed.
On a failed stage: roll back to the last
successful execution, no PR is opened.
branch rule: CI bot may merge
Argo CD pulls each overlay into its own cluster
- One build per commit. Promotion changes a digest in Git, never rebuilds.
- CI writes only to the dev overlay. Staging and prod overlays need a gate or a human.
- Config and image move together: a prod PR shows the image diff and the YAML diff.
- Argo CD has read-only Git access. Nobody has kubectl write in prod except break-glass.
